purpose: Teach: キヤノン/ジョージア/ミシガン/オハイオ/ジャスコ/早川書房/皇居/東北大学

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがキヤノンの一眼レフを下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is giving you a Canon DSLR camera.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Soft smile in the voice. Slight pause after his name, making space for the good news to land. Even pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとジョージアコーヒー飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I had Georgia coffee with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery with natural childish energy. Slight rush on the exciting part. Open mouth on the vowels. Wanting to share something small that felt big to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがミシガン州の絵本を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me a picture book about Michigan.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Slight emphasis on the sharing — the intimacy of being shown something by his father. Warm but thoughtful, not performative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとオハイオの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a picture book about Ohio with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, eager voice. Slight breathlessness like he's remembering the moment. Small child genuinely excited to report back what he experienced. Nasal openness on 'Ohio.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジャスコ跡地のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me a story about the old Jusco site.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly nostalgic tone. Pace slows — she's thinking about what she was told, turning it over in her mind. Tender without sadness. Listening-quality voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが早川書房のSF絵本貸して下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad lent me a science fiction picture book from Hayakawa Publishing.
lines.style: Eager, proud child voice. Emphasis on the specific publisher — he's learned a name and wants to say it right. Slight breathlessness under the words. Wanting approval for what Dad trusted him with.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが皇居の絵本を読んで下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad read me a picture book about the Imperial Palace.
lines.style: Quiet reverence in the voice. Pace deliberate, almost ceremonial — the Imperial Palace has weight. She's remembering the moment of being read to, of his presence. Tender, present-tense care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、東北大学に憧れてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really admire Tohoku University.
lines.style: Earnest, sincere. Direct eye contact in the voice. No performance, no deflection. A small boy being serious about a big dream. Slight tremor of vulnerability underneath — trusting her with something he cares about.
